details:
The VRChat website has a page for "String Loading", "Image Loading" and "Video Players", where it documents the allowed sources that can be used by creators and others, the problem is these lists are outdated and don't include most of what's actually being allowed.

I think these should be updated for transparency, security and privacy reasons.

https://creators.vrchat.com/worlds/udon/string-loading

https://creators.vrchat.com/worlds/udon/image-loading

https://creators.vrchat.com/worlds/udon/video-players/www-whitelist/
